messages:
sarah-oncall: CI on master turned red — integration matrix failing across nodes. Dashboard shows pg replica lag (~120s) and mock-redis returning 503s. anyone on infra? :confused:

james-enginfra: looking now. mock-redis pod in ci-namespace is CrashLoopBackOff and pg replica replay_lag ~118s. grabbing logs :hourglass_flowing_sand:

james-enginfra: kubectl -n ci get pods | grep redis-mock
james-enginfra: redis-mock-0   CrashLoopBackOff   0/1   ...
james-enginfra: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T02:45:12Z] ERR bind: resource temporarily unavailable
[2026-03-17T02:45:13Z] 503 service unavailable
```

ravi-ci: ci-bot shows failing workflow ci/integration (job #578). suggest a targeted rerun and a bisect to find first bad test. /retest?

linda-qa: I can bisect the failing tests, which test class was first red in the matrix?

sarah-oncall: looks like failures cluster around tests/integration/replication_test.py and a couple redis-backed flaky tests.

ravi-ci: /retest 578

ci-bot: @ravi-ci triggered rerun of ci/integration#578 — queued :repeat:

james-enginfra: quick mitigation: scaled redis-mock to 3 replicas and restarted the pod. also rolled back this morning's networkpolicy tweak (PR #3247) which may have caused flaps.
james-enginfra: pg replica lag -> 30s after the restart.

linda-qa: starting bisect locally against replication_test with deterministic seed, will report back in ~15m.

sarah-oncall: if rerun passes we'll still want postmortem: infra spike + potential timing window exposed by migration.

linda-qa: bisect result: failing commit 9f4b2a3 (migrations/adjust-timeouts). seems the timeout change exposes timing-sensitive assertions when replica lag spikes.

ravi-ci: rerun results: linux-py3.11 node passed, others still in progress.
james-enginfra: pg lag down to ~4s, redis-mock steady on 3 replicas. health checks green.

sarah-oncall: ok — infra-induced lag + migration timing. short-term fix: add small wait in replication_test and open follow-up to adjust migration or add stronger sync in test. creating issue now. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Integration pipeline run 579 finished — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

sarah-oncall: closing this thread, thanks all. last_message_ts 2067890345
